message: Campaign c-20261011-060545-bc28 starting: 5 rounds (auto, auto, auto, auto, auto).

Chaos Planner — LLM agent (groq/openai/gpt-oss-120b) chose cpu_throttle on payment-service: High‑impact CPU throttling on payment-service, never tried recently and only once before, maximises learning about critical service resilience while adding fault type variety.
GO: payment-service at 2/2 Ready, system 100% healthy. Blast radius: 2 dependent service(s) ['api-gateway', 'order-service'], ~100% of users, risk HIGH.

Anomaly confirmed on payment-service 10s after injection: pattern matches high latency. Isolation Forest score -0.068 (threshold +0.103), severity 0.95. LSTM forecast for the next 60s: score -0.063 (still anomalous).

Root cause localised to payment-service (cpu throttle, confidence 95%). api-gateway, order-service also deviate as callers of payment-service: its failure propagates to them. Change evidence: pod payment-service-7745b65785-hmgd7 CPU limit is 25m vs declared 500m; pod payment-service-7745b65785-kt8nc CPU limit is 25m vs declared 500m.
Confidence in resource_restore: 0.65 (history 0.80 over 1 attempt(s) x RCA 0.95 x blast factor 0.85). Decision: resource_restore on payment-service (fallback rolling_restart, confidence 0.65).
Executing resource_restore on payment-service.
resource_restore succeeded in 2.1s — resized 2 container(s) in place to {'payment-service': {'requests': {'cpu': '100m', 'memory': '96Mi'}, 'limits': {'cpu': '500m', 'memory': '256Mi'}}}.
payment-service verified functional: 2/2 replicas Ready and 5 consecutive user-path probes OK (last 6ms).
Round teardown for payment-service: no residual fault found; autoscaler returned to declared bounds.

payment-service recovered: detected in 9.84s, mitigated in 7.63s, fully back to its normal operating band in 54.99s (target 90s — MET). Users saw 5 failed requests out of 1289 (0.4%) during the incident.

Chaos Planner — LLM agent (groq/openai/gpt-oss-120b) chose network_partition on api-gateway: High‑impact api‑gateway network partition, long idle time, never used in this campaign, and critical downstream dependencies.
Waiting for steady state before injecting: steady state not met: product-service currently anomalous.
